mod.artifacts.armageddons blade.descript:
Reworks Armageddon's Blade as a six-component combination artifact and replaces its full immunity with strong protection from fire magic.

## Artifact Changes

- After assembly, all six components remain equipped and keep their own effects.
- Together with its components, the completed set provides a total of **+10** to all primary skills.
- A hero with a Spell Book can cast **Armag. Blade**, a special **0-mana Armageddon spell**.
- Fire spells deal **50% more damage**.
- All allied creatures take **75% less damage from fire spells**.
- The completed set generates **+1 sulfur per day**.

Armageddon's Blade does not grant a Spell Book automatically.
mod.artifacts.boots of reinforcement.des:
Adds **Boots of Reinforcement**, a fused combination artifact focused on army logistics and adventure-map mobility.

## Artifact Changes

- **Boots of Reinforcement** are assembled from **Boots of Speed**, **Equestrian's Gloves**, **Wayfarer's Boots** and **Angel Wings**.
- All four components are consumed during assembly.
- The completed artifact is classified as a **Relic**.
- The hero moves across rough terrain without additional movement point penalties.
- A hero with a **Spell Book** can cast **Reinforcements** once per day while wearing the artifact.
- **Reinforcements** allows the hero to exchange already recruited creatures with an owned town.
- **Fire Magic** improves the spell, granting additional land movement on the next day, town selection and, at Expert level, full flying movement.
- Next-day movement and flying effects require the hero to continue wearing the artifact.

## Component Changes

- **Equestrian's Gloves** are reclassified as a **Major artifact**.
- **Boots of Speed** are reclassified as a **Relic**.

The artifact does not automatically grant a **Spell Book**.

mod.artifacts.cornucopia.description:
Enhances **Cornucopia** with a stacking per-hero synergy for allied rare-resource production specialists.

## Artifact Changes

- Counting component effects, **Cornucopia** provides its owner's kingdom with **+5 mercury, sulfur, crystal and gems per day**.
- While the artifact is carried by a hero, each allied hero with a rare-resource production specialty provides that hero's owner with an additional **+4 of every rare resource per day**.
- A specialist carrying **Cornucopia** receives both effects, for a total of **+9 of every rare resource per day**.
- Bonuses from multiple specialists stack.

The synergy applies to **Calid, Rissa, Saurug, Sephinroth and Andal**.
mod.artifacts.diplomatic artifacts.name: Diplomatic Artifacts
mod.artifacts.diplomatic artifacts.descr:
Reworks diplomatic artifacts and their interaction with Shackles of War.

## Artifact Changes

* **Statesman's Medal**, **Diplomat's Ring** and **Ambassador's Sash** now each reduce surrender cost by **15%**.
* **Diplomat's Cloak** is now a fused artifact: its components are consumed during assembly and cannot be recovered.
* The completed cloak keeps a **50% surrender discount**.
* The completed cloak increases the chance that neutral creatures will join the hero's army.
* The completed cloak acts as **Expert Disguise** on the adventure map.
* **Diplomacy** surrender discounts are rebalanced to **15% / 25% / 50%**.
* **Shackles of War** still prevent retreat and surrender, but a hero with **Expert Diplomacy** or **Diplomat's Cloak** neutralizes that effect in battles where retreat or surrender is normally available.

This module does not implement the HotA siege-surrender effect for defending towns.
mod.artifacts.golden goose.name: Golden Goose
mod.artifacts.golden goose.description:
Enhances **Golden Goose** with a stacking per-hero synergy for allied heroes with **Estates** and rebalances the classes of its component artifacts.

## Artifact Changes

- Counting component effects, **Golden Goose** provides its owner's kingdom with **+5250 gold per day**.
- While the artifact is carried by a hero, each allied hero with **Estates** provides the player controlling that hero with an additional **+3000 gold per day**.
- A bearer with **Estates** receives both effects, for a total of **+8250 gold per day**.
- Bonuses from multiple heroes with **Estates** stack.

## Artifact Classes

- **Endless Purse of Gold** — Treasure
- **Endless Bag of Gold** — Minor
- **Endless Sack of Gold** — Major
- **Golden Goose** — Relic
mod.artifacts.leather armor of swiftness:
Adds **Leather Armor of Swiftness**, a fused speed relic created from three movement artifacts:

- **Ring of the Wayfarer** — grants **+1 Speed**
- **Cape of Velocity** — grants **+2 Speed**

Completed relic effects:

mod.creatures.name: Creatures
mod.creatures.description:
Creature-focused modules for Hirki Plus Patch (H.P.P.).

This parent module groups classic creature changes outside the New Luck and New Intelligence subsystems. These modules add new active abilities, unique creature spells, support spellcasting, and deeper battlefield roles to selected creatures.

Detailed mechanics, thresholds, duration values, targeting rules, and presentation notes are described in the individual child modules.

## Creature Spellcasters

* **Armadillos** — **Armadillo** and **Bellwether Armadillo** gain **Stone Skin** spellcasting for supporting other allied units. Their number of casts scales with stack size.
* **Efreets** — **Efreet** and **Efreet Sultan** gain **Protection from Fire** spellcasting. Their number of casts and spell duration scale with stack size.
* **Gunfighters** — **Gunslinger** and **Bounty Hunter** gain **Precision** spellcasting for supporting allied shooters.
* **Priests** — **Monk** and **Zealot** gain restorative and support spellcasting. **Monk** casts **Cure**, while **Zealot** adds stronger **Cure** and mass **Bless** support.
* **Zombies** — **Walking Dead** and **Zombie Lord** gain their own unique Death Ripple-like spell named **Grave Ripple**. **Zombie Lord** casts a stronger version with better scaling.

## Creature Special Abilities

* **Cerberus** — gains **Threefold Bite**, an active focused-strike ability that turns its next attack into a single-target triple-damage melee strike.
* **Hydras** — **Hydra** and **Chaos Hydra** gain the **Bloodwake** chain, increased durability, and Pulse abilities that damage nearby enemies while applying persistent Speed and Defense reductions.
mod.creatures.armadillos.name: Armadillos
mod.creatures.armadillos.description:
Armadillo and Bellwether Armadillo gain Stone Skin spellcasting.

## Shared Features

* **Spell** — both units cast **Stone Skin**.
* **Targeting** — both units can cast **Stone Skin** on other allied units, but not on their own stack.
* **Duration** — each **Stone Skin** effect applied by these units lasts 3 turns.
* **Scaling** — the number of casts scales with the number of units in the stack.

## Armadillo

* **Spell level** — casts **Basic Stone Skin**.
* **Casts** — 1 cast at 8 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 16 or more units in the stack, then +1 additional cast for every 50 units in the stack.

## Bellwether Armadillo

* **Spell level** — casts **Advanced Stone Skin**.
* **Casts** — 1 cast at 6 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 12 or more units in the stack, then +1 additional cast for every 50 units in the stack.
mod.creatures.cerberus.name: Cerberus
mod.creatures.cerberus.description:
Cerberus gains **Threefold Bite**, an active focused melee strike.

## Threefold Bite

* **Activation** — Cerberus activates **Threefold Bite** without spending its action.
* **Attack** — on its next melee attack, Cerberus hits only one target and deals triple damage.
* **Damage modifiers** — damage still follows normal melee damage modifiers, such as Offense.
* **Target retaliation** — the struck target can retaliate.
* **Cerberus retaliation** — while **Threefold Bite** is active, Cerberus cannot retaliate.
* **Three-headed attack** — while **Threefold Bite** is active, Cerberus does not use its normal three-headed attack.
* **Uses** — the ability has 3 uses per combat and gains +1 additional use for every 40 units in the stack.
mod.creatures.efreets.name: Efreets
mod.creatures.efreets.description:
Efreet and Efreet Sultan gain Protection from Fire spellcasting, giving both units a new battlefield support role that fits their fire-based identity.

## Shared Features

* **Spell** — both units cast **Protection from Fire**.
* **Targeting** — both units can cast **Protection from Fire** on other allied units, but not on their own stack.
* **Scaling** — both the number of casts and spell duration scale with the number of units in the stack.

## Efreet

* **Spell level** — casts **Basic Protection from Fire**.
* **Casts** — 1 cast at 4 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 14 or more units in the stack, and 3 casts at 28 or more units in the stack.
* **Duration** — each **Protection from Fire** effect applied by this unit starts at 3 turns and gains +1 additional turn for every 7 additional units in the stack after 13.

## Efreet Sultan

* **Spell level** — casts **Advanced Protection from Fire**.
* **Casts** — 1 cast at 3 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 11 or more units in the stack, and 3 casts at 22 or more units in the stack.
* **Duration** — each **Protection from Fire** effect applied by this unit starts at 3 turns and gains +1 additional turn for every 5 additional units in the stack after 9.

## Animation

* **Spellcasting:** both Efreet units use an unused creature animation prepared in the original game assets.
mod.creatures.gunfighters.name: Gunfighters
mod.creatures.gunfighters.description:
Gunslinger and Bounty Hunter gain Precision spellcasting.

The number of casts scales with stack size, while each Precision effect applied by these units lasts 3 turns.

## Shared Features

* **Spell** — both units cast **Precision**.
* **Targeting** — both units can cast **Precision** on other allied shooter units, but not on their own stack.
* **Duration** — each **Precision** effect applied by these units lasts 3 turns.
* **Scaling** — the number of casts scales with the number of units in the stack.
* **Compatibility** — this module does not require New Ranged. If the New Ranged Precision module is active, these units use the active version of Precision.

## Gunslinger

* **Casts** — 1 cast at 2 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 6 or more units in the stack, and 3 casts at 12 or more units in the stack.

## Bounty Hunter

* **Casts** — 1 cast at 2 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 5 or more units in the stack, and 3 casts at 10 or more units in the stack.
mod.creatures.hydras.name: Hydras
mod.creatures.hydras.description:
Hydra and Chaos Hydra gain the Bloodwake chain, a staged active ability system that lets them gather power and release damaging pulses around themselves.

## Shared Features

* **Increased durability** — **Hydra** now has 200 Health and 20 Defense. **Chaos Hydra** now has 300 Health and 25 Defense.
* **Bloodwake** — both units can activate **Bloodwake** on themselves to unlock later abilities in the chain.
* **Uses** — **Bloodwake** and **Pulse** abilities share a pool of 20 uses per combat.
* **Dispel protection** — Bloodwake states cannot be removed by **Dispel**.
* **Pulse targeting** — Pulse abilities affect nearby enemy units only.
* **Scaling** — Pulse damage scales with the number of units in the stack.

## Bloodwake Chain

* **Bloodwake 1** — the Hydra spends its turn gathering strength. On the next round, it can use **Pulse I** or advance to **Bloodwake 2**. This state lasts 4 rounds.
* **Bloodwake 2** — the Hydra spends its turn gathering greater fury. On the next round, it can use **Pulse I**, **Pulse II**, or advance to **Bloodwake 3**. This state lasts 3 rounds.
* **Bloodwake 3** — the Hydra enters a frenzy-like state until its next attack.

## Pulse I

* **Effect** — deals 70 damage × the number of Hydras in the stack to nearby enemy units and reduces their Speed.
* **Persistence** — the Speed reduction lasts until the end of combat, cannot be removed by **Dispel**, and can combine with other Speed-reducing effects.
* **Stacking** — the Speed reduction is cumulative, but Speed cannot be reduced below 2.
* **Hydra** — affects enemies within 1 hex and reduces Speed by 1.
* **Chaos Hydra** — affects enemies within 2 hexes and reduces Speed by 2.

## Pulse II

* **Effect** — deals 105 damage × the number of Hydras in the stack to nearby enemy units and reduces their Defense.
* **Persistence** — the Defense reduction lasts until the end of combat, cannot be removed by **Dispel**, and can combine with other Defense-reducing effects.
* **Stacking** — the Defense reduction is cumulative.
* **Hydra** — affects enemies within 1 hex and reduces Defense by 3.
* **Chaos Hydra** — affects enemies within 2 hexes and reduces Defense by 4.
mod.creatures.priests.name: Priests
mod.creatures.priests.description:
Monk and Zealot gain restorative and support spellcasting.

## Shared Features

* **Scaling** — the number of casts scales with the number of units in the stack.

* **Casts** — 1 cast at 4 or more units in the stack and 2 casts at 16 or more units in the stack.

* **Shared casts** — 1 cast at 3 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 12 or more units in the stack, and 3 casts at 24 or more units in the stack.

mod.creatures.zombies.name: Zombies
mod.creatures.zombies.description:
Walking Dead and Zombie Lord gain their own unique Death Ripple-like spell named Grave Ripple.

## Shared Features

* **Casts** — 1 cast at 20 or more units in the stack, 2 casts at 200 or more units in the stack, then +1 additional cast for every 200 units in the stack.

mod.heroes.name: Heroes
mod.heroes.melodia.name: Melodia
mod.heroes.melodia.description:
Reworks Melodia into a Luck support hero.

Melodia starts with Basic Wisdom, Basic Luck, and Fortune. Her Lady Luck specialty grants +1 Luck to all creatures in her army and protects them from ordinary Luck penalties.

Devils, Arch Devils, and Luck-reducing artifacts cannot bring her army **below +1 Luck**. The Misfortune spell can still overcome this protection, while Cursed Ground and Hourglass of the Evil Hour can suppress positive Luck entirely.

## Starting Setup

* **Skills:** Basic Wisdom, Basic Luck
* **Spell:** Fortune

## Specialty

* **Lady Luck:** +1 Luck for all creatures in Melodia's army, with protection against ordinary Luck penalties

## Display Note

Due to a VCMI display limitation, **Melodia may appear twice** in the Luck modifier list. This is expected and does not mean her specialty grants +2 Luck. One entry represents the +1 Luck bonus, while the other represents the protection effect that keeps her army from falling below +1 Luck against ordinary penalties. The final Luck value shown by the game **remains correct**.
mod.heroes.roland.name: Roland

Bone Dragons, Ghost Dragons, and Morale-reducing artifacts cannot bring his army **below +1 Morale**. The Sorrow spell can still overcome this protection, while Cursed Ground and Spirit of Oppression can suppress positive Morale entirely.

## Starting Setup

* **Skills:** Basic Leadership, Basic Armorer
* **Spell:** none

## Specialty

* **The King:** +1 Morale for all creatures in Roland's army, with protection against ordinary Morale penalties

## Display Note

Due to a VCMI display limitation, **Roland may appear twice** in the Morale modifier list. This is expected and does not mean his specialty grants +2 Morale. One entry represents the +1 Morale bonus, while the other represents the protection effect that keeps his army from falling below +1 Morale against ordinary penalties. The final Morale value shown by the game **remains correct**.

mod.new intelligence.name: New Intelligence
mod.new intelligence.description:
A larger Intelligence rework designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module keeps HotA-style maximum mana values for Intelligence and adds a combat mana bonus during battle:

* **Basic Intelligence** — increases maximum mana by 20% and grants 5 additional combat mana.
* **Advanced Intelligence** — increases maximum mana by 35% and grants 10 additional combat mana.
* **Expert Intelligence** — increases maximum mana by 50% and grants 15 additional combat mana.

Selected magical, mystical, or knowledge-themed allied creatures can further support **heroes with Intelligence** by granting additional **total combat mana** based on army composition and stack size. Different supported creature lines can be combined to increase the total combat mana bonus, **but splitting the same supported creature into multiple stacks does not duplicate its support bonus**. Where both a base creature and its upgrade are supported by the same module, using them together is allowed and can contribute to that line's support bonus.

## Creature Support Overview

Creature support is handled through separate optional modules. Exact thresholds and values are listed in each individual creature module description.

Supported creature lines include:

* **Mages** — both **Mage** and **Arch Mage** can provide support.
* **Priests** — both **Monk** and **Zealot** can provide support.
* **Sea Witches** — both **Sea Witch** and **Sorceress** can provide support.
* **Liches** — both **Lich** and **Power Lich** can provide support.
* **Shamans** — both **Shaman** and **Great Shaman** can provide support.
* **Unicorns** — both **Unicorn** and **War Unicorn** can provide support.
* **Psychic and Magic Elementals** — both **Psychic Elemental** and **Magic Elemental** can provide support.
* **Couatls** — both **Couatl** and **Crimson Couatl** can provide support.
* **Enchanter** — **Enchanter** can provide support.
* **Faerie Dragon** — **Faerie Dragon** can provide support.
* **Ogre Mage** — only the upgraded **Ogre Mage** can provide support.
* **Pit Lord** — only the upgraded **Pit Lord** can provide support.
* **Yeti Runemaster** — only the upgraded **Yeti Runemaster** can provide support.
* **Medusa Queen** — only the upgraded **Medusa Queen** can provide support.
* **Greater Basilisk** — only the upgraded **Greater Basilisk** can provide support.
mod.new intelligence.creatures.name: Intelligence Creatures
mod.new intelligence.creatures.descripti:
Creature support modules for New Intelligence, designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

These optional modules add Intelligence-based combat mana support to selected magical, mystical, or knowledge-themed creature lines. Exact thresholds, scaling values, and creature-specific details are listed in each individual module description.

## Included Creature Support

* **Mages** — **Arch Mages** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Mages**.
* **Priests** — **Zealots** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Monks**.
* **Sea Witches** — **Sorceresses** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Sea Witches**.
* **Liches** — **Power Liches** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Liches**.
* **Shamans** — **Great Shamans** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Shamans**.
* **Unicorns** — **War Unicorns** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Unicorns**.
* **Psychic and Magic Elementals** — **Magic Elementals** start contributing at a smaller required stack size and provide much stronger **total combat mana** support than base **Psychic Elementals**.
* **Couatls** — both **Couatls** and **Crimson Couatls** start providing support from a stack of 1 creature. **Crimson Couatls** provide stronger support than base **Couatls** and gain uncapped late **total combat mana** scaling from very large stacks.
* **Ogre Mage** — expands the spellcasting identity of **Ogre Mages** by giving them an additional magical support role through Intelligence-based **total combat mana**.
* **Pit Lord** — expands the dark spellcasting identity of **Pit Lords** with Intelligence-based **total combat mana** support, giving them an additional magical role.
* **Medusa Queen** — expands the mystical identity of **Medusa Queens** with Intelligence-based **total combat mana** support, giving them an additional magical role.
* **Greater Basilisk** — expands the petrifying mystical nature of **Greater Basilisks** with Intelligence-based **total combat mana** support, giving them an additional magical role.
* **Yeti Runemaster** — gives **Yeti Runemasters** Intelligence-based **total combat mana** support, expanding their runic mystical role.
* **Enchanter** — gives **Enchanters** Intelligence-based **total combat mana** support, reinforcing their neutral spellcaster role.
* **Faerie Dragon** — gives **Faerie Dragons** magical support based on Intelligence, with uncapped **total combat mana** scaling.
mod.new intelligence.creatures.couatls.d:
A support module for Couatls and Crimson Couatls designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module lets Couatl and Crimson Couatl stacks support **heroes with Intelligence** by granting additional combat mana based on the total stack size in the hero's army. Couatls provide strong early support with a hard cap, while Crimson Couatls start stronger and gain major late scaling from very large stacks. Listed values are **total combat mana** bonuses granted by each creature line at each threshold.

## Combat Mana Support

* **Couatl** — requires Intelligence and at least 1 Couatl. Couatl support is capped at 20 Couatls.
  * **Basic Intelligence**: 1 or more Couatls grant 8 **total combat mana**; 6 grant 14; 12 grant 18; 20 grant 24.
  * **Advanced Intelligence**: 1 or more Couatls grant 12 **total combat mana**; 6 grant 21; 12 grant 27; 20 grant 36.
  * **Expert Intelligence**: 1 or more Couatls grant 16 **total combat mana**; 6 grant 28; 12 grant 36; 20 grant 48.

* **Crimson Couatl** — requires Intelligence and at least 1 Crimson Couatl. Crimson Couatls keep scaling after 40.
  * **Basic Intelligence**: 1+ Crimson Couatls grant 10 **total combat mana**; 5 grant 18; 10 grant 24; 18 grant 30; 30 grant 35; 40 grant 40.
  * **Advanced Intelligence**: 1 or more Crimson Couatls grant 15 **total combat mana**; 5 grant 27; 10 grant 36; 18 grant 45; 30 grant 50; 40 grant 55.
  * **Expert Intelligence**: 1 or more Crimson Couatls grant 20 **total combat mana**; 5 grant 36; 10 grant 48; 18 grant 60; 30 grant 65; 40 grant 70.
  * **Late scaling**: at 40+ Crimson Couatls, each additional stack unit adds 5 more **total combat mana**.
mod.new intelligence.creatures.enchanter:
A support module for Enchanters designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module lets Enchanter stacks support **heroes with Intelligence** by granting additional combat mana based on the total stack size in the hero's army. Enchanters reinforce their neutral spellcaster identity by providing strong magical support outside any specific town lineup. **Total combat mana** values are listed at each threshold.

## Combat Mana Support

* **Enchanter** — requires Intelligence and at least 2 Enchanters.
  * **Basic Intelligence**: 2 or more Enchanters grant 4 **total combat mana**; 4 grant 8; 8 grant 13; 16 grant 18; 28 grant 22; 40 grant 26.
  * **Advanced Intelligence**: 2 or more Enchanters grant 8 **total combat mana**; 4 grant 15; 8 grant 24; 16 grant 33; 28 grant 46; 40 grant 57.
  * **Expert Intelligence**: 2 or more Enchanters grant 12 **total combat mana**; 4 grant 27; 8 grant 47; 16 grant 70; 28 grant 97; 40 grant 115.
mod.new intelligence.creatures.faerie dr:

mod.new luck.name: New Luck
mod.new luck.description:
A dedicated Luck rework designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module keeps the original Luck skill values and expands Luck into a broader gameplay system:

* **Basic Luck** — increases the Luck of all hero's creatures by **1**, improving their chance to deal double damage with lucky strikes. **Positive Luck** can grant or improve chance-based creature abilities. **Negative Luck** can weaken such abilities. Additionally, it increases the chance of better rewards from adventure map objects. In creature banks, at this level it provides a **25%** chance for an upgraded reward. In the Pyramid, it provides a **25%** chance to discover an additional random level 4 spell if the hero has **Expert Wisdom**.
* **Advanced Luck** — increases the Luck of all hero's creatures by **2**, improving their chance to deal double damage with lucky strikes. **Positive Luck** can grant or improve chance-based creature abilities. **Negative Luck** can weaken such abilities. Additionally, it increases the chance of better rewards from adventure map objects. In creature banks, at this level it provides a **50%** chance for an upgraded reward. In the Pyramid, it provides a **50%** chance to discover an additional random level 4 spell if the hero has **Expert Wisdom**.
* **Expert Luck** — increases the Luck of all hero's creatures by **3**, improving their chance to deal double damage with lucky strikes. **Positive Luck** can grant or improve chance-based creature abilities. **Negative Luck** can weaken such abilities. Additionally, it increases the chance of better rewards from adventure map objects. In creature banks, at this level it provides a **75%** chance for an upgraded reward. In the Pyramid, it provides a **75%** chance to discover an additional random level 4 spell if the hero has **Expert Wisdom**.

Luck-based creature ability scaling is handled through separate optional creature modules. Luck-based spell interactions are handled through optional spell modules. Luck-based adventure map object interactions are handled through optional object modules. Exact affected creatures, spells, objects, thresholds and values are listed in each individual module description.

## Included Systems

* **Pendant of Courage** — changes Pendant of Courage to **relic class**, increases its value and reduces its bonus from +3 Luck and +3 Morale to +2 Luck and +2 Morale.

* **Luck Spells** — includes reworked **Fortune and Misfortune**. These spells use reduced mana costs and act as direct counters to each other while controlling positive and negative Luck more reliably. This category also includes **Magic Mirror Luck Scaling**, which can work together with the **Magic Mirror** rework from the spell category, allowing Luck to affect spell reflection chance when the relevant modules are enabled.

* **Luck Creature Abilities** — adds **Luck scaling** to selected creature abilities. Some creatures **gain a new** positive Luck unlock, while others have existing abilities modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Luck Objects** — adds optional Luck scaling for adventure map rewards, creature banks and the Pyramid. Exact supported objects, reward tables, chances and preserved native behavior are listed in the four child module descriptions.
mod.new luck.creatures.name: Luck Creature Abilities
mod.new luck.creatures.description:
Creature ability modules tied to the reworked luck system.

These modules make selected chance-based creature abilities interact with positive and negative Luck. Positive Luck can either improve an existing ability or grant a new chance-based ability to selected creatures. Negative Luck reduces selected existing abilities, but does not add penalties to creatures that only receive a positive Luck unlock.

## Included Creature Ability Changes

* **Aging** — gives **Bone Dragons** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Aging, while **Ghost Dragons** keep their existing Aging ability and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Blinding Attack and Resistance Aura** — adjusts both Blinding Attack and Spell Resistance Aura for **Unicorns** and **War Unicorns**. The upgraded version receives stronger positive Luck scaling.

* **Curse** — adjusts the standard Curse attack currently used by **Mummies**. This is the normal Curse effect, not a separate custom spell.

* **Death Blow and Curse** — gives **Black Knights** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Death Blow while also scaling their Curse attack. **Dread Knights** keep both existing attacks and have both Death Blow and Curse modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Death Stare** — only **Mighty Gorgons** are affected. They keep their existing Death Stare ability and have it modified by Luck. **Gorgons** are intentionally excluded because a positive Luck unlock for this ability would be too strong.

* **Disease** — gives **Walking Dead** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Disease, while **Zombie Lords** keep their existing Disease attack and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Freezing Shot** — gives **Shamans** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Freezing Shot, while **Great Shamans** keep their existing Freezing Shot attack and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Magic Mirror** — only **Faerie Dragons** are affected. This modifies their native Magic Mirror creature ability, not the Magic Mirror spell.

* **Paralyze** — gives **Manticores** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Paralyze, while **Scorpicores** keep their existing Paralyze attack and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Phoenix Rebirth** — adjusts the existing Rebirth ability of **Phoenixes** through positive and negative Luck.

* **Poison** — **Wyverns** gain a new positive Luck chance to trigger Poison. Existing Poison attacks are modified by Luck for **upgraded Wyverns**, **Sea Serpents** and **Haspids**. **Sea Serpents** use more conservative positive scaling.

* **Magic Resistance** — **Dwarves**, **Battle Dwarves** and **Crystal Dragons** keep their existing Magic Resistance ability and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

* **Stone Gaze** — **Basilisks**, **Greater Basilisks**, **Medusas** and **Medusa Queens** keep their existing Stone Gaze attacks and have them modified by Luck. The upgraded versions receive stronger positive Luck scaling.

* **Thunderbolt** — gives **Rocs** a new positive Luck chance to trigger Thunderbolt, while **Thunderbirds** keep their existing Thunderbolt attack and have it modified by positive and negative Luck.

mod.new luck.objects.name: Luck Objects

Adventure map object modules tied to the reworked Luck system in Hirki Plus Patch (H.P.P.).

These optional modules let the visiting hero's secondary skill **Luck** improve supported rewards while preserving native guards, visit rules, reset behavior and penalties unless a child module explicitly states otherwise. Luck from artifacts, spells, adventure map objects and temporary effects does not affect these reward tables.

* **Luck Scaling for Adventure Map Objects** — adjusts reward tables for supported adventure map objects and weekly resource locations.

* **Advanced Luck** — 50% chance to upgrade the selected reward to 7 sulfur or 1000 gold.
* **Expert Luck** — 75% chance to upgrade the selected reward to 7 sulfur or 1000 gold.

All outcomes use the standard Prospector message.
mod.new luck.objects.pyramid spell rewar:
Enhances the **Pyramid reward** according to the visiting hero's **secondary skill Luck**.

The native **random level 5 spell**, guards, one-time visit rule and empty-Pyramid penalty remain unchanged. If the hero can learn the level 5 spell, **Basic / Advanced / Expert Luck** provides a **25% / 50% / 75% chance** to discover an **additional random level 4 spell**.

Only the hero's **Luck skill mastery** affects this reward. Luck from artifacts, spells, adventure map objects and temporary effects does not apply.
mod.new luck.spells.name: Luck Spells
mod.new luck.spells.description:
Spell modules tied to the reworked luck system in Hirki Plus Patch (H.P.P.).

Modules in this category aim to make luck-control spells more practical, more reliable, and better integrated with the New Luck system, while preserving their original tactical role.

## Included Spell Changes

* **Fortune** — increases Luck and sets a minimum positive Luck result for affected allied units while the spell lasts. Luck-reducing artifacts and effects cannot bring affected units below that minimum. The artifact **Hourglass of the Evil Hour** can still suppress positive Luck entirely.

* **Misfortune** — decreases Luck and sets a maximum negative Luck result for affected enemy units while the spell lasts. Luck-raising artifacts and effects cannot raise affected units above that cap.

* **Magic Mirror** — allows Luck to affect the spell reflection chance of Magic Mirror. Positive Luck increases the chance to reflect hostile spells, while negative Luck reduces it. This module can work together with the **Magic Mirror** rework from the spell category, allowing protected stacks to receive controlled Luck-based bonuses to spell reflection chance when both modules are enabled.

**Fortune** and **Misfortune** use reduced mana costs and remain direct counters to each other.
mod.new luck.spells.fortune and misfortu:
A paired rework of Fortune and Misfortune designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module makes both luck-control spells more reliable and meaningful to cast while preserving their original tactical relationship as direct counters to each other.

Both spells also use reduced mana costs to make them more practical choices in real gameplay.

## Spell Changes

* **Fortune** — increases Luck and **guarantees a minimum positive Luck** result for affected units while the spell lasts.
  * **No mastery**: +1 Luck, minimum +1 Luck, 5 mana.
  * **Basic**: +1 Luck, minimum +1 Luck, 4 mana.
  * **Advanced**: +2 Luck, minimum +2 Luck, 3 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all allied units, +2 Luck, minimum +2 Luck, 2 mana.

* **Misfortune** — decreases Luck and **guarantees a maximum negative Luck** result for affected units while the spell lasts.
  * **No mastery**: -1 Luck, maximum -1 Luck, 7 mana.
  * **Basic**: -1 Luck, maximum -1 Luck, 5 mana.
  * **Advanced**: -2 Luck, maximum -2 Luck, 4 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all enemy units, -2 Luck, maximum -2 Luck, 3 mana.
mod.new luck.spells.magic mirror luck sc:
Adds Luck-based scaling to the reflection chance of the Magic Mirror spell.

This module affects the Magic Mirror spell, not the native Magic Mirror ability of Faerie Dragons. Positive Luck increases the chance to reflect hostile spells, while negative Luck reduces it. The additional spell resistance from the Magic Mirror spell rework is not affected.

## Spell Changes

* **Magic Mirror** — its spell reflection chance is adjusted by the protected stack's current Luck.
  * **-3 or lower Luck**: reflection chance is reduced by 10%.
  * **-2 Luck**: reflection chance is reduced by 7%.
  * **-1 Luck**: reflection chance is reduced by 3%.
  * **+1 Luck**: reflection chance is increased by 10%.
  * **+2 Luck**: reflection chance is increased by 20%.
  * **+3 or higher Luck**: reflection chance is increased by 30%.

This module can work together with the Magic Mirror spell rework from the Spells category, applying these controlled Luck-based modifiers to the reworked spell.
mod.new ranged.name: New Ranged
mod.new ranged.description:
A ranged combat rework for Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This mod makes ranged units, ammunition, war machines, and shooter-support spells work as a more coherent system. Ammo becomes a real resource, Archery and Artillery interact more strongly, and selected artifacts and spells better support ranged combat tactics.

## Included Systems

* **Shooter Ammo** — sets a new baseline ammo pool for ranged units. Upgraded units usually receive more ammo than their base versions, while selected special units have their own values.

* **Ammo Cart** — in the New Ranged package, acts as an additional ammo source instead of granting unlimited shots. It supplies allied ranged units with +5 maximum ammo for the current battle.

* **Archery** — increases ranged unit damage, improves maximum ammo by **+1 / +3 / +5** at Basic, Advanced, and Expert levels, and at higher levels extends full-damage shooting range. At Expert level, ranged attacks apply **Basic Forgetfulness**.

* **Artillery** — preserves the classic Ballista control, double-shot, and double-damage progression, while also protecting Ballista, Cannon, and their linked Ammo Carts from losing too much Health from a single attack.

* **Archery and Artillery Synergy** — with Artillery, Ballista and Cannon can receive matching Archery bonuses based on both skill levels.

* **Precision** — improves ranged attacks for allied shooters. At higher levels, it also extends their full-damage shooting range and grants +1 Speed for the spell duration.

* **Ranged Heroes** — Torosar starts with Basic Artillery instead of Basic Mysticism, better supporting his Ballista specialty.

* **Ranged Artifacts** — Golden Bow, Bow of the Sharpshooter, and Ammo Cart are adjusted to fit the new ranged combat economy.
mod.new ranged.creatures.name: Ranged Creatures
mod.new ranged.creatures.description:
Creature modules for the New Ranged package.

Modules in this category rework shooter ammunition so ammo becomes a real resource and better interacts with Archery, the Ammo Cart, and the overall ranged combat economy.

## Changed Elements

* **Shooter Ammo** — sets a new baseline ammo pool for ranged units. Base shooters usually have less ammo, upgraded versions usually receive an additional shot, and selected special units, such as **Sea Dog** and **Titan**, have their own values. **Ballista** also has reduced ammo to better fit the New Ranged system.

## System Interactions

* **Archery** can increase the maximum ammo pool of ranged units during combat.
* The New Ranged **Ammo Cart** acts as an additional ammo source instead of granting unlimited shots.
mod.new ranged.creatures.shooterammo.des:
Creates a fixed shooter ammo baseline for the New Ranged package.

This module standardizes the maximum ammo of ranged units so ammo becomes a real resource, and bonuses from Archery and the Ammo Cart matter more.

## Ammo Baseline

* **Tier 1–3 base shooters** — usually have 4 shots.
* **Tier 4–6 base shooters** — usually have 5 shots.
* **Most upgraded shooters** — gain +1 shot compared to their base version.
* **Sea Dog** — has 6 shots.
* **Titan** — has 7 shots.
* **Ballista** — has reduced ammo, down to 16 shots.

## System Interactions

* **Archery** can increase the maximum ammo pool of ranged units during combat.
* The New Ranged **Ammo Cart** acts as an additional ammo source instead of granting unlimited shots.
mod.new ranged.heroes.name: Ranged Heroes
mod.new ranged.heroes.description:
Hero-side ranged and war machine adjustments for the New Ranged package.

* **Torosar** — keeps **Torosar** starting with **Basic Tactics**. His original **Basic Mysticism** is replaced by **Basic Artillery**, better supporting his **Ballista** specialty and the New Ranged package.
mod.new ranged.heroes.torosarartillery.d: Keeps Torosar starting with Basic Tactics. His original Basic Mysticism is replaced by Basic Artillery, better supporting his Ballista specialty and the New Ranged package.
mod.new ranged.skills.name: Ranged Skills
mod.new ranged.skills.description:
Secondary skill modules for the New Ranged package.

Modules in this category rework **Archery** and **Artillery** to better support ranged units, ranged war machines, and synergy between them.

## Changed Skills

* **Archery** — increases ranged unit damage, improves their maximum ammo with stronger Advanced and Expert bonuses, and at higher levels extends their full-damage shooting range. At Expert level, ranged attacks apply **Basic Forgetfulness** to the target.

* **Artillery** — preserves the classic Ballista control, double-shot, and double-damage progression, while also protecting **Ballista**, **Cannon**, and their linked **Ammo Carts** from losing too much Health from a single attack.

## Skill Synergy

With **Artillery**, **Ballista** and **Cannon** can receive matching **Archery** bonuses based on both skill levels.
mod.new ranged.skills.archery.name: Archery
mod.new ranged.skills.archery.descriptio:
Reworks the **Archery** skill for the New Ranged package.

## Skill Changes

* **Basic Archery** — increases damage dealt by ranged units by 15% and increases their maximum ammo by 1.
* **Advanced Archery** — increases damage dealt by ranged units by 25%, increases their maximum ammo by 3, and extends their full-damage shooting range by 1 hex, up to 11 hexes.
* **Expert Archery** — increases damage dealt by ranged units by 50%, increases their maximum ammo by 5, extends their full-damage shooting range by 1 hex, up to 11 hexes, and makes their ranged attacks apply **Basic Forgetfulness** to the target.

## Artillery Synergy

With **Artillery**, **Ballista** and **Cannon** can receive matching **Archery** bonuses based on both skill levels.
mod.new ranged.skills.artillery.name: Artillery
mod.new ranged.skills.artillery.descript:
Reworks the **Artillery** skill for the New Ranged package.

## Skill Changes

* **Basic Artillery** — gives the hero control of the **Ballista**. Ballista shots have a 50% chance to deal double damage. **Ballista** and its **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 50% of their Health from a single attack. **Cannon** and its linked **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 40%.
* **Advanced Artillery** — gives the hero control of the **Ballista**. The **Ballista** shoots twice per round, and its shots have a 75% chance to deal double damage. **Ballista** and its **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 40% of their Health from a single attack. **Cannon** and its linked **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 30%.
* **Expert Artillery** — gives the hero control of the **Ballista**. The **Ballista** shoots twice per round, and its shots always deal double damage. **Ballista** and its **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 30% of their Health from a single attack. **Cannon** and its linked **Ammo Cart** cannot lose more than 20%.

## Archery Synergy

With **Archery**, **Ballista** and **Cannon** can receive matching **Archery** bonuses based on both skill levels.
mod.new ranged.spells.name: Ranged Spells
mod.new ranged.spells.description: Spell modules for the New Ranged package. Currently includes Precision, which keeps early mastery close to the original spell while Advanced and Expert Precision gain additional ranged-combat utility.
mod.new ranged.spells.precision.name: Precision
mod.new ranged.spells.precision.descript:
Reworks Precision for the New Ranged package.

## Spell Changes

* **No Mastery / Basic Precision** — increases target allied shooter's Attack by +3 for ranged attacks only.
* **Advanced Precision** — increases target allied shooter's Attack by +6 for ranged attacks only. **Additionally**, extends its full-damage shooting range by 1 hex, up to 11 hexes, and grants +1 Speed for spell duration.
* **Expert Precision** — increases all allied shooters' Attack by +6 for ranged attacks only. **Additionally**, extends their full-damage shooting range by 2 hexes, up to 12 hexes, and grants +1 Speed for spell duration.
mod.objects.name: Objects
mod.objects.description:
Object-focused modules for Hirki Plus Patch.

This parent module groups optional adventure map object changes. These modules may expand existing objects, add new reward logic, adjust creature-bank outcomes, or introduce additional map interactions while preserving the original identity and role of each object whenever possible.

Detailed reward values, visit rules, object scope and compatibility notes are described in the individual child modules.

## Current Object Modules

* **Creature Upgrade Objects** — a collection of adventure map object modules that add free creature upgrade or transmutation rewards, similar in spirit to how **Stables** can upgrade **Cavaliers** into **Champions** without a resource cost.
* **Spit - Hydra Reward** — turns **Spit** into a Fortress-flavored creature bank reward, replacing gold with **Hydras** while keeping the original guards, visuals, layout, terrain placement and object behavior.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.des:
Optional adventure map object modules that add creature upgrade or transmutation effects.

These modules expand selected map objects with additional creature progression rewards while preserving the original purpose of each object whenever possible. All added upgrades are free, similar to how **Stables** can upgrade **Cavaliers** into **Champions** without a resource cost. Specific upgrade paths, visit rules and limitations are described in each child module.

## Available Modules

* **Magic Spring - Arcane Transmutation** — preserves the normal **Magic Spring** mana-doubling effect and adds arcane transmutation paths for **Mages**, **Arch Mages** and **Ogres**. **Enchanters** are also globally aligned with **Tower**, giving them **snow** as native terrain while this module is active.
* **Sanctuary - Monk Consecration** — preserves the normal **Sanctuary** protective role and adds a thematic upgrade path: **Monks** into **Zealots**.
* **Swan Pond - Unicorn Blessing** — preserves the normal **Swan Pond** luck reward and adds a thematic upgrade path: **Unicorns** into **War Unicorns**.
* **Cover of Darkness - Embrace of Darkness** — preserves the normal **Cover of Darkness** shroud effect and adds a dark knightly ascension: **Black Knights** into **Dread Knights**.
* **Mermaids - Oceanid's Call** — preserves the normal **Mermaids** luck reward and adds a Cove-themed upgrade path: **Nymphs** into **Oceanids**.
* **Faerie Ring - Sprite Awakening** — preserves the normal **Faerie Ring** luck reward and adds a fairy upgrade path: **Pixies** into **Sprites**.
* **Pillar of Fire - Efreet Ascension** — preserves the normal **Pillar of Fire** scouting effect and adds a fiery upgrade path: **Efreet** into **Efreet Sultans**.
* **Redwood Observatory - Elven Sharpshooter Training** — preserves the normal **Redwood Observatory** scouting role and adds a one-time elven training path: **Wood Elves** into **Grand Elves**, then **Grand Elves** into **Sharpshooters**.
* **Trailblazer - Wasteland Training** — preserves the normal **Trailblazer** wasteland movement bonus and adds wilderness training paths: **Ogres** into **Ogre Magi** and **Shamans** into **Great Shamans**.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.cov: Cover of Darkness - Embrace of Darkness

Preserves the normal **Cover of Darkness** shroud effect and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits a **Cover of Darkness**, the object still hides the surrounding lands as usual. In addition, if the hero has **Black Knights**, the darkness can embrace those units and transform them into **Dread Knights**.

## Embrace of Darkness

* **Black Knights** are transformed into **Dread Knights**.
* Heroes without Black Knights receive only the normal Cover of Darkness effect.

This keeps the object's original map-control role while giving Necropolis Black Knights a thematic opportunity to fully surrender to darkness on the adventure map. The object remains repeatable, matching the original unlimited visit behavior of Cover of Darkness.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.fae:
Preserves the normal **Faerie Ring** luck reward and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits a **Faerie Ring**, the object still grants its normal **+1 Luck** bonus for the next battle. In addition, if the hero has **Pixies**, the faerie magic can awaken them into **Sprites**.

## Sprite Awakening

* **Pixies** are transformed into **Sprites**.
* Heroes without Pixies receive only the normal Faerie Ring luck reward.

## Visit and Luck Rules

The transformation only happens when the **Faerie Ring** can actually bless the hero with its luck effect. If the hero already has the active Faerie Ring bonus, the object remains unavailable until that bonus expires.

This keeps the free transformation tied to real use of the Faerie Ring's blessing and prevents repeated upgrades without first using the received luck.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.mag:
Preserves the normal **Magic Spring** mana-doubling effect and adds thematic creature transmutation rewards.

When a hero successfully uses a **Magic Spring**, the spring still doubles the hero's mana as usual. In addition, it can transform allied spellcasters and magically gifted creatures in the hero's army.

## Arcane Transmutation

* **Arch Mages** are transformed into **Enchanters**.
* If the hero has no Arch Mages, **Mages** are transformed into **Arch Mages** instead.
* **Ogres** can be transformed into **Ogre Magi** in parallel with the highest available Mage-line transformation.

If the hero has **Mages**, **Arch Mages**, and **Ogres**, only **Arch Mages** and **Ogres** are transformed during that visit; **Mages** remain unchanged.

## Enchanter Tower Alignment

**Enchanters** are globally aligned with **Tower**, giving them **snow** as native terrain while this module is active.

## Visit and Mana Rules

Transformations only happen when the Magic Spring can actually double the hero's mana. If the hero still has doubled mana from a previous Magic Spring visit, creature transformations will not trigger, even after the weekly visit reset.

This keeps the free transformations tied to real use of the spring's magic and prevents repeated upgrades without spending the doubled mana first.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.mer:
Preserves the normal **Mermaids** luck reward and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits **Mermaids**, the object still grants its normal **+1 Luck** bonus for the next battle. In addition, if the hero has **Nymphs**, the mermaids can answer the call of their kin and transform those units into **Oceanids**.

## Oceanid's Call

* **Nymphs** are transformed into **Oceanids**.
* Heroes without Nymphs receive only the normal Mermaids luck reward.

## Visit and Luck Rules

The transformation only happens when **Mermaids** can actually bless the hero with their luck effect. If the hero already has the active Mermaids bonus, the object remains unavailable until that bonus expires.

This keeps the free transformation tied to real use of the Mermaids' blessing and prevents repeated upgrades without first using the received luck.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.pil:
Preserves the normal **Pillar of Fire** reveal effect and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits a **Pillar of Fire**, the object still reveals nearby terrain as usual. In addition, if the hero has **Efreets**, the fire of the pillar can elevate them into **Efreet Sultans**.

## Efreet Ascension

* **Efreets** are transformed into **Efreet Sultans**.
* Heroes without Efreets receive only the normal Pillar of Fire reveal effect.

## Unlimited Visit Rules

The **Pillar of Fire** keeps its original unlimited visit behavior. The ascension can therefore happen again if a hero later brings new Efreets to the object.

This follows the object's native behavior instead of replacing it with an artificial one-time limit, while still requiring actual Efreets for every free upgrade.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.red:
Preserves the normal **Redwood Observatory** terrain reveal effect and adds a one-time elven creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits a **Redwood Observatory**, the object still reveals the surrounding lands. In addition, the observatory can train elven shooters once per object. After the training has been used, later visits continue to reveal terrain but no longer grant additional upgrades.

## Elven Sharpshooter Training

* **Grand Elves** are transformed into **Sharpshooters**.
* **Wood Elves** are transformed into **Grand Elves**.
* If the hero has both Wood Elves and Grand Elves, only the stronger upgrade is applied: **Grand Elves -> Sharpshooters**.

## Visit Rules

The upgrade reward is available only once per Redwood Observatory. Heroes without eligible elven units still use the observatory normally and reveal nearby terrain without consuming the one-time training reward. Once the upgrade reward is used, the observatory remains useful as a normal reveal object on later visits.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.san:
Preserves the normal **Sanctuary** protective role and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero enters **Sanctuary**, the object still protects that hero as usual. In addition, if the hero has **Monks**, the sanctuary can consecrate those units into **Zealots**.

## Monk Consecration

* **Monks** are transformed into **Zealots**.
* Heroes without Monks receive only the normal Sanctuary protection message.

This keeps the object's original defensive role while giving Castle monks a thematic upgrade opportunity on the adventure map.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.swa:
Preserves the normal **Swan Pond** luck reward and adds an additional creature upgrade reward.

When a hero visits a **Swan Pond**, the object still grants its normal **+2 Luck** bonus for the next battle and consumes the hero's remaining movement as usual. In addition, if the hero has **Unicorns**, the pond can bless those units and transform them into **War Unicorns**.

## Unicorn Blessing

* **Unicorns** are transformed into **War Unicorns**.
* Heroes without Unicorns receive only the normal Swan Pond reward.

This keeps the object's original luck-based role while giving Rampart Unicorns a thematic upgrade opportunity on the adventure map.
mod.objects.creature upgrade objects.tra:
Allows **Trailblazer** to train selected wasteland warriors while preserving its normal weekly movement bonus on wasteland terrain.

When a hero can receive the Trailblazer bonus, eligible units may also be upgraded. **Shamans** become **Great Shamans**, and **Ogres** become **Ogre Magi**. If both unit lines are present in the army, both upgrades are applied during the same visit. Heroes without eligible units receive only the normal Trailblazer effect.

The module keeps the native bonus-based visit behavior of Trailblazer: a hero who already has the active weekly Trailblazer effect cannot use the object again until that effect expires.
mod.objects.spit - hydra reward.name: Spit - Hydra Reward
mod.objects.spit - hydra reward.descript:
Spit becomes a Fortress-flavored creature bank that rewards Hydras instead of gold.

## Reward Changes

* **Reward type** — Spit now rewards **Hydras** instead of gold.
* **Reward scaling** — stronger Spit variants reward 1, 2, 3, or 4 Hydras.
* **Guards** — Spit keeps its Basilisk guards, with four guard stacks scaling by object strength.
* **Scope** — this module only changes Spit rewards and keeps the original visuals, layout, terrain placement, and object behavior.
mod.skills.name: Skills
mod.skills.estates.name: Estates
mod.skills.first aid.name: First Aid
mod.skills.first aid.description:
Enhances First Aid by increasing the durability of the First Aid Tent with each skill level, allowing the hero to benefit from its army health bonus for longer.

First Aid Tent increases the maximum health of all creatures in the hero's army. This core effect is preserved, while the Tent also gains a stronger damage cap as the skill improves. At Expert level, the Ammo Cart also receives damage cap protection.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic First Aid:** First Aid Tent increases creature maximum health by 5%; First Aid Tent cannot lose more than 40% of its maximum health from a single attack
* **Advanced First Aid:** First Aid Tent increases creature maximum health by 10%; First Aid Tent cannot lose more than 30% of its maximum health from a single attack
* **Expert First Aid:** First Aid Tent increases creature maximum health by 15%; First Aid Tent and Ammo Cart cannot lose more than 20% of their maximum health from a single attack

## Specialist Interaction

First Aid specialties increase only the First Aid Tent's creature maximum health bonus with hero level, and do not increase the damage cap.
mod.skills.leadership.name: Leadership
mod.skills.leadership.description:
Expands **Leadership** into a Morale and adventure-map momentum skill.

Leadership keeps its original Morale bonuses and adds **Inspired March**. After visiting an adventure map object that grants positive Morale for the next battle, the hero immediately receives additional movement points. This bonus is added on top of any native movement reward from the object.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic Leadership:** +1 Morale; Inspired March grants +100 movement points
* **Advanced Leadership:** +2 Morale; Inspired March grants +200 movement points
* **Expert Leadership:** +3 Morale; Inspired March grants +300 movement points

## Supported Objects

* **Buoy**
* **Fountain of Youth**
* **Idol of Fortune**
* **Oasis**
* **Rally Flag**
* **Temple**
* **Watering Hole**

Idol of Fortune grants Inspired March movement only on days when it provides Morale.

## Specialist Interaction

Inspired March movement bonuses depend only on Leadership mastery and are not increased by Leadership specialties.
mod.skills.mysticism.name: Mysticism
mod.skills.mysticism.description:
Enhances Mysticism as a mana recovery and adventure-map momentum skill.

Mysticism keeps the Horn of the Abyss daily spell point regeneration and adds Mystic Momentum. After successfully casting selected adventure-map control spells, the hero gains additional movement on the next day. Each supported spell can grant its own bonus once per day.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic Mysticism:** regenerates 10% of maximum spell points per day, minimum 5; Mystic Momentum bonuses for Dimension Door, Water Walk, Summon Boat, and Scuttle Boat
* **Advanced Mysticism:** regenerates 20% of maximum spell points per day, minimum 10; adds Mystic Momentum bonuses for Fly and Town Portal, and improves all supported control spell bonuses
* **Expert Mysticism:** regenerates 30% of maximum spell points per day, minimum 15; further improves all Mystic Momentum bonuses

## Supported Mystic Momentum Spells

* **Basic:** Dimension Door, Water Walk, Summon Boat, Scuttle Boat
* **Advanced and Expert:** Fly, Town Portal, Dimension Door, Water Walk, Summon Boat, Scuttle Boat

## Specialist Interaction

Mysticism specialties increase only the spell point regeneration with hero level, and do not increase Mystic Momentum movement bonuses.

## Implementation Note

Mystic Momentum works after successfully casting a supported adventure-map control spell. The movement bonus is granted on the next day. Movement bonuses from different supported spells can add together, but each supported spell can grant its bonus only once per day.
mod.skills.navigation.name: Navigation
mod.skills.navigation.description:
Improves **Navigation** into a more flexible water travel skill.

Navigation keeps its original water movement bonus and now also allows heroes to board and disembark ships without ending the turn. Remaining movement is converted between land and water movement during the transition, so the exact amount preserved depends on the hero's current movement and movement modifiers.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic Navigation:** +50% movement over water and free ship boarding/disembarking
* **Advanced Navigation:** +100% movement over water and free ship boarding/disembarking
* **Expert Navigation:** +150% movement over water and free ship boarding/disembarking

## Specialist Interaction

Navigation specialties increase only the specialist hero's water movement with hero level, and do not increase the free boarding/disembarking effect directly.
mod.skills.scouting.name: Scouting
mod.skills.scouting.description:
Improves **Scouting** into a stronger exploration and information support skill.

Scouting keeps its hero-only scouting radius bonus and now also improves Thieves' Guild access for the hero's owner and any allies. In solo games, the owner receives the full information benefit; in allied games, the same benefits are shared across the team.

Benefits from multiple Scouting heroes on the same team can stack, making the skill more useful while preserving its exploration identity.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic Scouting:** +1 scouting radius for the hero and +1 Thieves' Guild access for the hero's owner and allies
* **Advanced Scouting:** +2 scouting radius for the hero and +2 Thieves' Guild access for the hero's owner and allies
* **Expert Scouting:** +3 scouting radius for the hero and +3 Thieves' Guild access for the hero's owner and allies

## Specialist Interaction

Scouting specialties increase only the specialist hero's own scouting radius with hero level, and do not increase Thieves' Guild access.
mod.skills.sorcery.name: Sorcery
mod.skills.sorcery.description:
Reworks **Sorcery** into a combat spellpower amplifier.

Sorcery now increases the hero's **Spell Power during combat**, strengthening all spells cast in battle and fully scaling for heroes specialized in Sorcery.

## Skill Effects

* **Basic Sorcery:** +10% Spell Power during combat
* **Advanced Sorcery:** +20% Spell Power during combat
* **Expert Sorcery:** +30% Spell Power during combat
mod.spells.name: Spells
mod.spells.acid-burst.name: Acid Burst
mod.spells.acid-burst.description:
Adds **Acid Burst**, a level 4 Water Magic spell designed to gradually corrode enemy forces during prolonged battles.

The spell begins with a small penalty that increases by another point at the start of each subsequent turn. Its duration depends on the hero's Spell Power, while repeated casts refresh the duration without resetting the accumulated penalty.

## Spell Effects

* **Acid Burst** — progressively reduces enemy Defence and, at higher mastery levels, also Attack, up to a maximum reduction of 10 points for each affected stat.
  * **No mastery**: reduces the Defence of one enemy stack, 16 mana.
  * **Basic**: keeps the same effect, 12 mana.
  * **Advanced**: reduces the Attack and Defence of one enemy stack, 12 mana.
  * **Expert**: reduces the Attack and Defence of all enemy stacks, 12 mana.

Acid Burst can appear in the Mage Guilds of Cove, Conflux, Tower and Necropolis.
mod.spells.ice-storm.name: Ice Storm
mod.spells.ice-storm.description:
Adds **Ice Storm**, a level 4 Water Magic spell that summons a violent storm over the entire battlefield.

The spell damages every creature present. On **Snow** terrain, each affected stack for which Snow is not native terrain has a chance before each of its turns for 2 turns to freeze and skip that turn entirely. The chance is **10% / 20% / 25% / 30%** at no, Basic, Advanced and Expert Water Magic mastery.

War machines receive the spell's damage but are excluded from the freezing effect. Water Elementals, Ice Elementals, Nymphs and Oceanids are fully immune to Ice Storm.

Ice Storm can appear in level 4 Mage Guilds of Bulwark and Tower with gainChance 10, and Cove and Conflux with gainChance 5. Other towns remain at 0.
mod.spells.magic mirror.name: Magic Mirror
mod.spells.magic mirror.description:
A base rework of Magic Mirror prepared for later integration with New Luck.

This module adjusts the spell's mana costs, adds a chance to resist hostile spells at higher Air Magic mastery levels, and turns the Expert version into a mass defensive spell. Luck-based scaling is intentionally left for a separate New Luck module.

## Spell Changes

* **Magic Mirror** — reflects hostile spells and, at higher mastery levels, also grants a chance to resist hostile spells.
  * **No mastery**: keeps the original behavior, 20% reflection chance, 25 mana.
  * **Basic**: keeps the original Basic behavior, 20% reflection chance, 20 mana.
  * **Advanced**: 25% reflection chance and 15% chance to resist hostile spells, 18 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all allied stacks, 25% reflection chance and 20% chance to resist hostile spells, 24 mana.
mod.spells.mirth - sorrow.name: Mirth and Sorrow Independent Morale
mod.spells.mirth - sorrow.description:
A paired rework of Mirth and Sorrow designed for use with Horn of the Abyss on VCMI.

This module makes both morale-control spells more reliable and meaningful to cast while preserving their original tactical relationship as direct counters to each other.

Both spells also use reduced mana costs to make them more practical choices in real gameplay.

## Spell Changes

* **Mirth** — increases Morale and **guarantees a minimum positive Morale** result for affected units while the spell lasts.
  * **No mastery**: +1 Morale, minimum +1 Morale, 7 mana.
  * **Basic**: +1 Morale, minimum +1 Morale, 5 mana.
  * **Advanced**: +2 Morale, minimum +2 Morale, 4 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all allied units, +2 Morale, minimum +2 Morale, 3 mana.

* **Sorrow** — decreases Morale and **guarantees a maximum negative Morale** result for affected units while the spell lasts.
  * **No mastery**: -1 Morale, maximum -1 Morale, 12 mana.
  * **Basic**: -1 Morale, maximum -1 Morale, 9 mana.
  * **Advanced**: -2 Morale, maximum -2 Morale, 7 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all enemy units, -2 Morale, maximum -2 Morale, 5 mana.
mod.spells.slayer.name: Slayer
mod.spells.slayer.description:
A focused rework of Slayer designed to make the spell a more practical anti-elite combat tool.

This module keeps Slayer situational, but makes each level of Fire Magic meaningfully improve how the spell performs against the strongest creatures in battle.

## Spell Changes

* **Slayer** — increases damage against level 7 and higher creatures.
  * **No mastery**: keeps the original Slayer behavior, 16 mana.
  * **Basic**: affects all level 7 and higher creatures, 14 mana.
  * **Advanced**: affects all level 7 and higher creatures; repeated casts on the same stack stack the effect, 12 mana.
  * **Expert**: affects all allied stacks; repeated casts stack the effect, 10 mana.
mod.towns.name: Towns
mod.towns.description:
Town modules for Hirki Plus Patch.

This parent module groups optional changes related to **town buildings**, **faction identity** and town-based rewards. These modules may expand existing buildings, add new reward logic or create additional town interactions while preserving the original role of each town whenever possible.

Detailed requirements, rewards and rules are described in the individual child modules.

## Current Town Modules

* **Elemental Ritual** — lets heroes sacrifice complete creature sets in selected towns in exchange for thematic rewards.

* **Resource Specialist Silos** — gives rare-resource specialists a weekly reward from visited Resource Silos.

* **Gold Specialist Halls** — gives gold-focused heroes a weekly City Hall reward, with Lord Haart included as a unique Estates-themed exception.
mod.towns.elemental ritual.name: Elemental Ritual
mod.towns.elemental ritual.description:
Adds access to **Elemental Rituals** in the **Mage Guild Level 3** building in selected towns:

- **Conflux** — **Fire**, **Water** or **Air**.
- **Tower** — **Water** or **Air**.
- **Castle** and **Stronghold** — **Air**.
- **Rampart**, **Fortress**, **Cove** and **Bulwark** — **Water**.
- **Inferno**, **Dungeon** and **Factory** — **Fire**.

A hero visiting the town may sacrifice a complete **Fire**, **Water** or **Air** creature set to receive the matching **elemental Tome** and **elemental Orb**.

Required creature sets:

**Fire set:**
- **2 Firebirds**
- **2 Phoenixes**
- **4 Efreets**
- **4 Efreet Sultans**
- **10 Fire Elementals**
- **10 Energy Elementals**
- Requires also **1 Magic Elemental** as the catalyst.

**Water set:**
- **12 Water Elementals**
- **12 Ice Elementals**
- **32 Nymphs**
- **32 Oceanids**
- **2 Jotunns**
- **2 Jotunn Warlords**
- Requires also **1 Magic Elemental** as the catalyst.

**Air set:**
- **12 Air Elementals**
- **12 Storm Elementals**
- **2 Angels**
- **2 Archangels**
- **6 Rocs**
- **6 Thunderbirds**
- Requires also **1 Magic Elemental** as the catalyst.

Full set bonus:
- a hero carrying a complete elemental set temporarily gains **all spells of the matching magic school** in their spell book;
- the hero also receives at least **Advanced mastery** of that magic school;
- the bonus lasts only while the required creatures remain in the army.

Limits:
- each town can perform its **Elemental Ritual** only once;
- **Conflux** and **Tower** can perform only one of their available rituals.

Intentionally excluded:
- **Earth Magic** — not supported because it is too strong and universally useful;
- **Necropolis** — excluded because it would most naturally fit Earth Magic, which this module deliberately avoids strengthening.
mod.towns.gold specialist halls.name: Gold Specialist Halls
mod.towns.gold specialist halls.descript:

Each **City Hall** can automatically grant **4000 gold** once per week to the first eligible hero visiting the town.

Eligible heroes:

mod.towns.resource specialist silos.name: Resource Specialist Silos
mod.towns.resource specialist silos.desc:
